name: O!Мega-3 TG
headline: O!Мega-3 TG
description: Essential omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids in the restored triglyceride form. This form is close to the natural one but with a high concentration of omega-3, making it easier to keep up a healthy rhythm of life.
howToUse: Adults and children over 14 – 1 capsule three times a day with food. Course: 1 month, repeated if needed.

manufacturing.expiration: 3 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Omega-3 concentrate 650 mg from ocean fish oil (anchovy, sardine, mackerel, tuna), including EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) 360 mg and DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) 240 mg, vitamin E (D-alpha-tocopherol) 6.71 mg.
